nodes.label: createCartesianCharts()
nodes.desc: Curried factory that binds layout='horizontal' or 'vertical' onto AreaChart/BarChart/LineChart/ComposedChart/ScatterChart for typed chart contexts.

nodes.label: LineChart
nodes.desc: forwardRef wrapper: chartName='LineChart', defaultTooltipEventType='axis', tooltipPayloadSearcher=arrayTooltipSearcher.

nodes.label: BarChart
nodes.desc: Same wrapper shape as LineChart; passes chartName='BarChart' into CartesianChart.

nodes.label: CartesianChart
nodes.desc: Resolves defaultCartesianChartProps (barCategoryGap '10%', barGap 4, syncMethod 'index'), wraps children in the store and reports props.

nodes.label: CategoricalChart
nodes.desc: Compact mode serves the Brush panorama without a wrapper div; normal mode nests RechartsWrapper > RootSurface > ClipPathProvider.

nodes.label: RechartsWrapper
nodes.desc: Rounds container size to integers, reports it via ReportChartSize and forwards all mouse/touch handlers.

nodes.label: RootSurface
nodes.desc: Wraps Surface with the chart layout context and event plumbing.

nodes.label: Surface
nodes.desc: The single <svg> element with class 'recharts-surface', viewBox and title/desc children.

nodes.label: ResponsiveContainer
nodes.desc: ResizeObserver callback optionally wrapped in es-toolkit throttle when the debounce prop is positive.

nodes.label: RechartsStoreProvider
nodes.desc: Lazily builds the store in a ref on first render; panorama children render without a Provider so selectors hit the root store.

nodes.label: createRechartsStore
nodes.desc: RechartsRootState combines 18 reducers; middlewares for mouse click/move, keyboard, external and touch events; autoBatchEnhancer queues notify on requestAnimationFrame.

nodes.label: useAppSelector
nodes.desc: Subscribes via context.subscription.addNestedSub with reference equality; outside a chart returns undefined instead of throwing.

nodes.label: createMouseMoveMiddleware
nodes.desc: Per-store closure keeps pending frame/timeout state; throttleDelay 'raf' uses requestAnimationFrame, a number uses setTimeout.

nodes.label: graphicalItemsSlice
nodes.desc: Stores settings for every Line/Bar/Area registered by SetCartesianGraphicalItem; exposes upsert/remove reducers.

nodes.label: cartesianAxisSlice
nodes.desc: BaseCartesianAxis settings keyed by AxisId (default 0), including scale type, domain and the niceTicks algorithm choice.

nodes.label: tooltipSlice
nodes.desc: TooltipState keeps independent item/axis interaction for click and hover, keyboard interaction, syncInteraction from other charts, payload configurations and settings.

nodes.label: chartDataSlice
nodes.desc: Holds the chart-level data array provided by ChartDataContextProvider, including Brush window slices.

nodes.label: layoutSlice
nodes.desc: Chart layout (horizontal/vertical), width/height, margins and the computed offset/plot area.

nodes.label: SetCartesianGraphicalItem
nodes.desc: Headless component each Line/Bar/Area renders to push its settings into the graphicalItems slice.

nodes.label: ReportChartProps
nodes.desc: Dispatches barCategoryGap, barGap, stackOffset, syncId and other root props into rootPropsSlice.

nodes.label: selectAxisScale
nodes.desc: 2300-line selector module: data domain, nice ticks, real scale type, zoomed range and the final RechartsScale per axis id.

nodes.label: selectNiceTicks
nodes.desc: Computes human-friendly tick values for numeric domains, honouring the niceTicks 'auto'/'adaptive'/'snap125'/'none' modes.

nodes.label: combineConfiguredScale
nodes.desc: Instantiates a d3 scale from victory-vendor by name (scalePoint, scaleLinear, ...) and applies domain and range.

nodes.label: getAdaptiveStep
nodes.desc: decimal.js-light arithmetic that rounds tick steps; getSnap125Step snaps to {1, 2, 2.5, 5} x 10^n.

nodes.label: combineDisplayedStackedData
nodes.desc: Builds per-index records of series identifier to numeric value, merging item-level and chart-level data for stacks.

nodes.label: combineTooltipPayload
nodes.desc: Parses each graphical item's tooltip entry settings into name/unit/color/fill entries with the final data resolution.

nodes.label: selectLinePoints
nodes.desc: Reselect selector producing the Line point list from both axis scales, layout and the line's settings.

nodes.label: combineAllBarPositions
nodes.desc: Turns barCategoryGap/barGap percentages and fixed barSize lists into x/y/width/height rectangles for every Bar.

nodes.label: Line
nodes.desc: Renders RegisterGraphicalItemId + SetCartesianGraphicalItem, reads points via useAppSelector, draws through Curve and LineDrawShape.

nodes.label: Bar
nodes.desc: Reads computed trapezoid positions from the store and renders Rectangle shapes with stack and background support.

nodes.label: CartesianAxis
nodes.desc: Defaults: minTickGap 5, tickSize 6, tickMargin 2, interval 'preserveEnd'; publishes rendered ticks via setRenderedTicks.

nodes.label: Tooltip
nodes.desc: Combines active interaction state with tooltip payload entries and renders DefaultTooltipContent inside a positioned box.

nodes.label: Legend
nodes.desc: Reads legend payload reported by each graphical item through SetLegendPayload and renders DefaultLegendContent.

nodes.label: useChartSynchronisation
nodes.desc: Charts sharing a syncId forward tooltip events; syncMethod 'index', 'value' or a custom function maps the incoming index.
